_doc: ADR-0064 D-E + ADR-0065 D-B: portable manifest for the product port and the G6 gates. Ships in the tarball at src/port/g6-manifest.json (ADR-0038 files whitelist covers src/). Vectorizer layer is hand-written JS (src/port/score.js); estimator layer is a hand-written dot product (allowed under D-E). sklearn-porter and ONNX are forbidden channels. Values are float64; quantization is forbidden (G6 logits < 1e-12).
serializer: item_text v1: task + events(message->text; tool_call->name+json.dumps(arguments,sort_keys); tool_result->content+is_error/truncated flags) + closing, LF-joined, empty parts dropped
